name: Lime Burst
description: A festive paint with a refreshing design, literally oozing freshness. Tanks coated in this paint will have a curiously acidic taste with a hint of lime. Few can resist the temptation to taste it.
interestingFacts: This paint was available in the garage during the 2017 March Holidays celebrations for 120,000 crystals on March 8, 2017.
This paint was added to containers on February 5th, 2021.
